album.album: A Tapestry of Souls: The Paradox of Light
album.AlbumPlot:
### "A Tapestry of Souls: The Paradox of Light" — The 0 GD Trilogy, Part II (Era II)
Anya, plucked from Auroria at the end of *The Awakening*, falls into the war-torn Underworld and meets Valen, her protector; in the frozen wastes she meets Seraphina and recognizes a shared, stranger nature. Their backstories surface — what the dark took from each (Seraphina's family and home, Valen's fallen — the ghosts of Ravenspire he carries). At the Celestial Gardens, Elara reveals Anya's truth: she is a Void-Echo, immune to the Void, a paradox of light — the Living Lock who must seal Nyktoros. She trains with Seraphina, discovers the Tablets that confirm her fate, and fights her first battle as a rebel — proving her worth. Valen masters her use of the Rift's power through resonance (she wields Vorgos's power, never claims his title). The war closes in; in the finale, Valen falls to the Legion — Anya's grief and her shattering power surface as the seal-fate takes hold. Ends on Valen's death — plunging into *Dawn of Ravenspire*.
